description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayBootstrapAuth functionality within the ai.openclaw.app package, specifically testing authentication logic and gateway trust prompts in the GatewayBootstrapAuthTest class.

classes.name: GatewayBootstrapAuthTest
classes.description: A test class verifying the behavior of gateway bootstrap authentication and gateway trust prompts in the OpenClaw app.

methods.name: skipsOperatorSessionWhenOnlyBootstrapAuthExists
methods.description: Tests that operator session is skipped when only bootstrap authentication exists.

methods.name: connectsOperatorSessionWhenSharedPasswordOrStoredAuthExists
methods.description: Tests that operator session connects when shared password or stored authentication exists.

methods.name: resolveOperatorSessionConnectAuthUsesStoredTokenPathAfterBootstrapHandoff
methods.description: Verifies that after bootstrap handoff, the auth resolves to null token auth.

methods.name: resolveOperatorSessionConnectAuthPrefersExplicitSharedAuth
methods.description: Ensures explicit shared authentication is prioritized when resolving auth.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectAuth_prefersExplicitSetupAuthOverStoredPrefs
methods.description: Checks that setup authentication takes priority over stored preferences.

methods.name: acceptGatewayTrustPrompt_preservesExplicitSetupAuth
methods.description: Test that accepting the trust prompt preserves explicit bootstrap authentication.

methods.name: connect_showsSecureEndpointGuidanceWhenTlsProbeFails
methods.description: Verifies that proper guidance is shown when TLS probe fails.

methods.name: waitForGatewayTrustPrompt
methods.description: Helper function to wait for trust prompt in runtime.

methods.name: waitForStatusText
methods.description: Helper function to wait for status text update.

methods.description: Retrieves desired bootstrap token from session object using reflection.
